# A recorded shape of this exporter's /metrics output, enough to exercise the
# S0-01 checks without a Mirth. Names, labels and meter types are taken from
# mirth_exporter.py; values are illustrative.
#
# Two channels, chosen to cover the case §13 item 2 turns on:
#   c1 adt-in   storage mode PRODUCTION, a destination with 7 queued messages
#               and an oldest-message age, so the bounded lookup is exercised
#   c2 orm-out  storage mode METADATA, which retains no destination queue, so
#               queue age is unobtainable rather than merely missing
#
# Storage mode is not in the exposition — it is read from the server and passed
# as MIRTH_STORAGE_MODES. See test/README.md.
# HELP mirth_up 1 when the Mirth REST API answered this scrape, else 0.
# TYPE mirth_up gauge
mirth_up{mirth_instance="prod-1"} 1.0
# HELP mirth_channels_observed Channels returned by /channels/statuses in this scrape.
# TYPE mirth_channels_observed gauge
mirth_channels_observed{mirth_instance="prod-1"} 2.0
# HELP mirth_messages_received Cumulative messages received by the channel.
# TYPE mirth_messages_received counter

mirth_messages_received{mirth_instance="prod-1",channelName="orm-out",channelId="c2"} 9120.0
